text.text_excerpt: We rarely treat ourselves to pizza, and were starving on a recent weeknight. There are only two pizza places near us in the Gentilly area. We decided on Pepperoni Ray's as it looked like customary pizza with normal types of toppings (I am not into super "fancy" pizza with toppings that don't belong on pizza). We called and left right away to pick it up - it was ready on time, exactly like they said it would be. (Note that the online ordering didn't work and the online hours said that the store was closed.). We enjoyed the pizza - It was hot and fresh and just what we needed. We will definitely be back. Small store with great, fast service.

The rating says it all. Excellent quality and customer service. So the fam and I visited a couple weeks ago and had a great experience, but I never got around to writing a review. So glad to see Pepperoni Ray's back in the neighborhood. I remember when they first opened about 9 years ago around the time I moved into the area. Ok, enough about me. Customer Service So we went again tonight and the experience was even better. Customer service was excellent. We didn't get her name, but she was very pleasant, knowledgeable and made us feel like family. She said she had only been working there for a couple days. Ray was his cool, professional, "I got this" self as always. We ordered the special...

I've heard about Pepperoni Ray's and have waited months to try it. I finally got a chance to order and omgee, I wish I would've tried it when I first heard about it. I ordered the cheesy bread and pizza. The cheesy bread had jalapeños in it. I don't even it jalapeños but I sure did that day! Page pizza is kept nice and warm until you arrive. My Mister ordered the wings and said he will continue to order them every time we go to Pepperoni Ray's. Don't miss out on this one.
